Saved Views is here, available today for everyone on a paid plan. It lets you capture your favorite filters, sorting, and grouping for any list, then jump back to that exact setup whenever you need it. No more rebuilding the same view from scratch each morning, and no more digging through menus trying to recall how you had things arranged last week.

Each user can save up to 50 views, so you can keep separate setups for every project, client, or workflow you manage, all ready to load in a single click. Saved Views can also be shared with your team, meaning everyone can work from the same configuration instead of comparing notes across different screens or repeating instructions.

This update is included in all paid plans starting today, with no extra cost and nothing to configure. Whether you're tracking sprints, reviewing a backlog, or planning your next launch, the view you want is always within reach.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
